import json,collections
p='research/kitaev/results/s3-fusion-ring.json';d=json.load(open(p,encoding='utf-8'));R=d['unordered_nontrivial_fusion_rules']
def fu(a,b):
 if a=='A':return [b]
 if b=='A':return [a]
 return R['x'.join(sorted((a,b)))]
def mul(X,Y):
 z=collections.Counter()
 for a,ma in X.items():
  for b,mb in Y.items():
   for c in fu(a,b):z[c]+=ma*mb
 return z
T={'C':1}
for x in 'CCF':T=mul(T,{x:1})
assert T==collections.Counter({'G':3,'H':3,'F':2})
t1=[(x,y)for x in fu('C','C')for y in fu(x,'C')if 'F'in fu(y,'F')]
t2=[(x,y)for x in fu('C','C')for y in fu('C',x)if 'F'in fu(y,'F')]
t3=[(x,z)for x in fu('C','C')for z in fu('C','F')if 'F'in fu(x,z)]
t4=[(x,y)for x in fu('C','C')for y in fu(x,'F')if 'F'in fu('C',y)]
t5=[(z,y)for z in fu('C','F')for y in fu('C',z)if 'F'in fu('C',y)]
expected=[[('C','A'),('C','B')],[('C','A'),('C','B')],[('C','G'),('C','H')],[('C','G'),('C','H')],[('G','H'),('H','G')]]
assert [t1,t2,t3,t4,t5]==expected
print(json.dumps({'total_multiplicities':dict(T),'selected_total':'F','five_parenthesization_paths':[t1,t2,t3,t4,t5],'all_selected_basis_dimensions':[2]*5},indent=2))
